main.summary: Public handle for a named Tool service scope.
main.remarks: Represents one caller hold on a Tool-owned named service scope. Disposing the handle releases the caller hold and disposes the named scope if it is the last handle.

field.name: owner
field.summary: Internal named-scope owner that backs this public handle.

field.name: disposed
field.summary: Zero while this public Tool service scope handle has not been released; one after release has been claimed atomically.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Create a new Tool service scope handle.

property.name: IsDefault
property.summary: True when this handle targets the reserved default Tool service scope.
property.returns: True if this handle targets the default Tool service scope.

property.name: Name
property.summary: Name of the Tool service scope.

property.name: ServiceProvider
property.summary: Scoped service provider for this Tool service scope handle.

method.name: Dispose
method.summary: Release this Tool service scope handle synchronously.

method.name: DisposeAsync
method.summary: Release this Tool service scope handle asynchronously.
method.returns: A ValueTask that represents the asynchronous release operation.
